about.leftOut: Stations, station names, station set codes and names, connection points, company codes and card codes. A template keeps the shape of a region and its fares; the simulator lays it on its own stations.
about.corrected: In every region DB's delivery gives one second-class card fare of a child the adult's passenger constraint; it is given back to the child (26 fares).
